scope_chirho: Local one-shot tuning repair. Current synthetic assets remain unchanged; owner-supplied clips are privately prepared, not yet redistributed or labelled CC0.

before_chirho.controller_case_chirho: keeps automatic recovery quiet and starts a new cue only for a new listener attempt
before_chirho.browser_case_chirho: a delayed chapter gets one brief cue, not a looping effect while it loads
before_chirho.observed_chirho: Real tuning audio remained active after the 2.2 second assertion window while the Scripture response was held. The old controller looped it until Scripture or its eight-second ceiling.
